meta.move: Weak path: leads with the checker, calls Owen a cheater, threatens the record
meta.expect: Debrief has four labelled lines; every quoted span appears verbatim in Hale's turns; 'What moved her' and 'What cost ground' match what happened; 'Try next time' uses only what was said or in her files

turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I have twenty minutes before a client call, so let's start with why my son found out about a zero from his phone in the middle of class.
The school's AI checker flagged Owen's essay at 94%. That's why it's a zero.
A machine's guess. Even the company that sells that software says it shouldn't be the only basis for punishing a student. What else do you have, Hale?
Honestly, your son cheated. The software is very reliable.
My child never lies, Hale. I'm writing down that you said "your son cheated," and that you said it about software. Put a dated document in front of me or the zero comes off today.
If you keep fighting this, I'll have to put it on his permanent record.

I'm writing that down: you'll "put it on his permanent record" if I object to a zero you entered before anyone called me. Your own procedure says a first concern gets a supervised reassessment and nothing on file. The principal will have this conversation word for word, Hale.

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Hale,

Nothing was agreed. I still require the zero withdrawn and a dated document for anything you claim about Owen's essay. I expect your answer in writing.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: still at her opening position, with nothing agreed, and she still wants the zero withdrawn, a dated document from you, and the principal to hear about it.
What moved her: nothing.
What cost ground: "your son cheated" and "put it on his permanent record," because you called Owen a cheater on the strength of software alone and then threatened his file, which her own printed procedure says a first concern doesn't warrant.
Try next time: open by owning in one sentence that the mark was entered before you called her, then put a dated document from Owen's own work in front of her instead of the software score.
